```yaml
name: Remove Experimental Decorators

on:
  schedule:
    # Run on the 1st day of each month at 00:00 UTC
    - cron: "0 0 1 * *"
  workflow_dispatch:

defaults:
  run:
    shell: bash

jobs:
  remove-experimental-decorators:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GH_TOKEN }}

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@0b93645e9fea7318ecaed2b359559ac225c90a2b # v5.3.0
        with:
          python-version: "3.10"

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install -r dev/requirements.txt

      - name: Run remove_experimental_decorators.py
        id: run_script
        run: |
          set -e
          SCRIPT_EXIT_CODE=0
          python dev/remove_experimental_decorators.py || SCRIPT_EXIT_CODE=$?
          
          if [ $SCRIPT_EXIT_CODE -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "Script failed with exit code $SCRIPT_EXIT_CODE"
            echo "WARNING: Script failed, but continuing to check for changes..."
          fi
          
          echo "script_exit_code=$SCRIPT_EXIT_CODE" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Check for changes
        id: check_changes
        run: |
          CHANGES_FOUND=$(git status --porcelain | wc -l)
          echo "changes_found=$CHANGES_FOUND" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Create branch and commit changes
        if: steps.check_changes.outputs.changes_found != 0
        run: |
          TIMESTAMP=$(date +"%Y-%m-%d-%H-%M-%S")
          BRANCH_NAME="automated/remove-experimental-decorators-$TIMESTAMP"
          
          git config --global user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config --global user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          
          git checkout -b "$BRANCH_NAME"
          
          git add .
          git commit -m "Automated removal of experimental decorators ($TIMESTAMP)"
          
          git push origin "$BRANCH_NAME"

      - name: Create Pull Request
        if: steps.check_changes.outputs.changes_found != 0
        run: |
          TIMESTAMP=$(date +"%Y-%m-%d-%H-%M-%S")
          TITLE="Automated removal of experimental decorators ($TIMESTAMP)"
          
          cat > /tmp/pr_body.txt << 'EOF'
          ## Automated Experimental Decorator Removal

          This PR was automatically generated to remove experimental decorators from the codebase.

          ### Changes Made
          - Removed experimental decorators from various components
          - Updated affected code to reflect non-experimental status

          ### Notes
          - This is an automated update
          - Please review the changes before merging
          - The script used: `dev/remove_experimental_decorators.py`

          ### Related
          - Workflow: `.github/workflows/remove-experimental-decorators.yml`
          EOF

          gh pr create \
            --title "$TITLE" \
            --body-file /tmp/pr_body.txt \
            --head "automated/remove-experimental-decorators-$TIMESTAMP" \
            --base "master" \
            --label "automated"

      - name: Fail if script failed
        if: steps.run_script.outputs.script_exit_code != 0
        run: |
          exit ${{ steps.run_script.outputs.script_exit_code }}
```
